label: SignalMasters

hero.title: SignalMasters — Rear-Facing Directional Warning
hero.subtitle: Direct rear-approaching traffic away from the scene with dedicated directional warning, available in full, ultra-slim, and compact configurations.

description: Federal Signal SignalMasters deliver dedicated rear-facing directional warning to reduce struck-by risk during roadside stops and scene work. Choose from the full-featured SignalMaster, the ultra-slim Latitude SignalMaster integrated into your light bar, or the compact MicroPulse SignalMaster.

products.label: SignalMaster™ Rear-Facing Directional Warning
products.tagline: Full-featured rear-facing directional warning in 4-head, 8-head, and 2x4-head configurations.

products.label: Latitude® SignalMaster
products.tagline: Ultra-slim rear-facing directional warning integrated into your light bar.

products.label: MicroPulse® SignalMaster
products.tagline: Compact directional warning that integrates with the MicroPulse system.
